title: tc-agent-plan
description: A step-by-step plan from an agent: reviewed and edited as a draft, then shown while it runs.

steps.description: The steps. Edits apply unless a tc-steps-change listener calls preventDefault()

status.description: "draft" = review and edit, "running" = executing, "done" = finished – always set by the app

heading.description: The goal of the plan, shown as the heading

estimate.description: Estimated run time shown in review, e.g. "~2 min"

cancellable.description: Shows a "Cancel" button next to "Run plan" (fires tc-cancel)

retryable.description: Shows "Retry from here" on failed steps (fires tc-retry)

rerunnable.description: Shows "Run again" once the plan is done (fires tc-run)

detail.description: A second, quieter line under the title

tool.description: Tool the agent will call, shown as a small mono chip, e.g. "search_web"

duration.description: How long the step took, in ms – shown next to done steps (measured live if left out)
